feedback: The geometry provides a good balanced baseline with moderate size, mass, and sensor layout, which should simplify controller tuning. The 5 sensors evenly spaced near the front give good line coverage, reducing the need for aggressive steering corrections. However, the moderate mass and wheel radius may limit acceleration and responsiveness, requiring the controller to compensate with more aggressive PID gains. The sensor size of 0.012 is a good middle ground for sensitivity and noise. To improve controller performance, I recommend trying: 1) Slightly increasing the wheel_track to 0.14 to improve lateral stability and reduce steering oscillation. 2) Increasing sensor_size to 0.016 to improve line detection robustness, especially in curves. 3) Slightly reducing body_length to 0.16 to improve agility and reduce inertia during turns. These changes should help the controller maintain smoother line following with fewer line loss events and less oscillation.
requested_changes: wheel_track to 0.14 for better lateral stability
sensor_size to 0.016 for improved line detection
